subject: Post-call: Novaflow trial ops plan & evaluation rubric
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@novaflow.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Novaflow trial ops plan & evaluation rubric

Hi Lisa — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC timeline this week.

Key goals we agreed on:
- Validate automated claim-extraction accuracy at scale (measured by field-level F1 on a 2k document test set).
- Confirm end-to-end latency under expected concurrency (target p95 < 400ms for request pattern in our doc).
- Prove safe redaction and retention controls for sensitive PHI-like fields per your compliance ask.

Qualification notes (from today):
- Peak concurrent sessions: ~40 for ingestion phase, steady-state ~8.
- Data sensitivity: highly regulated; retention & audit logs are gating items.
- Success criteria (proposal):
  1) Accuracy: field-level F1 >= 0.92 on the validation set agreed by both teams.
  2) Reliability: 99% of requests under 500ms at expected load during a 1-hour stress window.
  3) Security: evidence of audit logs and configurable retention policies meet Novaflow compliance checklist.

Proposed 4-week POC (flexible):
- Week 0 (kickoff): data mapping, access provisioning, SOW finalization.
- Week 1 (ingest & baseline): pipeline integration, baseline model run on sample data.
- Week 2 (tuning & guardrails): prompt engineering, caching config, quantization/profile if needed.
- Week 3 (stress & acceptance): load tests, acceptance criteria checks, compile readout.
- Final readout meeting: end of Week 3 (30–45 minute review + decisions).

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood onboarding lead: Monica Patel — integration, telemetry, runbook.
- Redwood AE / sponsor: Ben Carter — commercial, timelines.
- Redwood contracts: Aditya Rao — SOW/PO/contract coordination.
- Novaflow tech lead: Lisa Chen — data access, validation set owner.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the proposed success criteria above (accuracy/latency/security) or list edits.
2) Confirm the kickoff week availability — we proposed Jan 18–22; any blocking constraints?
3) Share initial data mapping answers using the attached template (novaflow-data-map-template.csv) — even a partial file helps us scope Week 1.
4) Aditya — I'll need the SOW edits (attached draft) and the procurement timeline from Novaflow to align contract milestones.

Attachments included: POC-SOW-draft.pdf (editable), novaflow-data-map-template.csv

Thanks — happy to sync 15 minutes if you prefer a quick alignment before kickoff.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@novaflow.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novaflow trial ops plan & evaluation rubric

Ben — really helpful summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Data & retention: we require a 30-day configurable retention policy for processed outputs and an immutable audit trail for who/when accessed records. Can Redwood provide an option for 30-day + ability to purge on demand for POC datasets?
2) Dedicated capacity vs hosted: for the POC we prefer a hosted setup first, unless you see a blocker for reproducing our performance/latency targets. If dedicated is recommended to hit p95 < 400ms at 40 concurrent, please flag it and estimate incremental cost.
3) Kickoff week: Jan 18 works for our engineering team. Prefer the kickstart on Jan 18 at 10:00 AM PT if that fits on your side.
4) Security review: I will loop in our security manager — they'll send a short questionnaire and may ask for a short SOC2 artifact. Expect that later today.

Attaching a short internal checklist (not the full security packet) — will follow up with any formal items.

If you can confirm the retention capability and whether hosted is likely sufficient, we'll finalize internal approvals and lock the Jan 18 slot.

Best,
Lisa
Head of ML Ops | Novaflow
Lisa.Chen@novaflow.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@novaflow.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novaflow trial ops plan & evaluation rubric

Hi Lisa — thanks, and welcome. Quick answers and an operational plan to make Jan 18 workable.

On retention & audit logs:
- Redwood supports configurable retention at dataset level; we can set a 30-day default and provide a one-click purge for assets used during the POC.
- Audit logs are available and we can export evidence (CSV) showing access events for the POC period. If you need signed attestations we can provide a short-run artifact post-POC.

Hosted vs Dedicated recommendation:
- For the POC target (40 concurrent peak, p95 < 400ms) we typically can meet it in our Hosted tier with tuned batching + KV caching for short sequences. Dedicated will reduce variability and is recommended at scale or for strict data isolation.
- I'll run a quick capacity estimate and share a delta on cost by EOD tomorrow if that helps your procurement conversation.

Operational kickoff (proposed):
- Kickoff: Jan 18, 2027 — 10:00 AM PT (45 minutes) — Agenda: introductions, access plan, data mapping review, acceptance criteria sign-off, next steps (owners & calendar).
- Pre-kickoff deliverables (due Jan 15): Novaflow completes the attached data-map template (partial OK), and provides a list of sample documents (S3 presigned or secure share).

Owners & immediate tasks: 
- Monica Patel (Redwood Onboarding): create runbook, instrument telemetry, own weekly check-ins.
- Aditya Rao (Redwood Contracts): finalize SOW and lead procurement/PO.
- Ben Carter (Redwood AE): exec sponsor and timeline decisions.
- Lisa Chen (Novaflow): validation set owner, security point-of-contact.

I created a kickoff calendar stub (kickoff-event.ics) and I'll send the official invite after Ben confirms. We'll also set up a weekly 30-minute check-in cadence for Tuesdays at 10am PT during the POC.

Quoted from Ben's plan above to preserve context:
> Proposed 4-week POC (flexible):
> - Week 0 (kickoff): data mapping, access provisioning, SOW finalization.
> - Week 1 (ingest & baseline): pipeline integration, baseline model run on sample data.
> - Week 2 (tuning & guardrails): prompt engineering, caching config, quantization/profile if needed.
> - Week 3 (stress & acceptance): load tests, acceptance criteria checks, compile readout.

If that schedule is agreeable I'll lock the invite for Jan 18 10:00 AM PT and share the meeting notes template so we can track acceptance gates.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Monica Patel
Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
